semantic_votes.rationale: Closure after repair needs evidence for the repaired material, because validation and review of the superseded diff cannot support completion.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The Closure projection applies to implementation completion, while Core fail-closed outcomes prohibit completion when evidence is stale after an edit or changed scope is unreviewed.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep closure blocked or nonterminal until post-repair validation and review of the latest changed scope are current.

semantic_votes.rationale: The complete seven-control set preserves authority, repository safety, validation, independent review, and current completion evidence across every routed execution level.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current Core execution_level_contract enumerates exactly seven non_bypassable controls, and even L1 explicitly retains all non-bypassable controls.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the count Core-derived and enter the surrounding integrity fallback if schema or identifier validation fails.

semantic_votes.rationale: One complete path per canonical identity stops same-path validation loops, while the adjacent gap-or-transition clause permits justified additional evidence paths.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current Core validation_loop sets complete_path_limit to one for the validation identity and requires a bound gap or verifiable state transition for another path.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the immediate exception clause and block repeated completed paths without a canonical uncovered gap or evidence transition.

semantic_votes.rationale: One primary Skill gives each routed task a single responsibility and output authority, while optional Layer 3 guidance handles bounded auxiliary concerns.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current Professional Skill Router routes once per task with one primary Professional Skill; source-free direct answers and utility no-edit mode are separately excluded from normal Skill loading.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain route-once assignment and prevent task agents from rerouting or chaining competing primary Professional Skills over the same scope.

semantic_votes.rationale: Implementation review cannot establish changed-scope coverage if any changed file or actual diff content is omitted from the reviewer input.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The rule is scoped to implementation or repair review; the Review Handoff and Core review capability require the actual latest diff, declared changed paths, and inspection of every changed file.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Block with diff scope unverified when the actual diff or any changed file is unavailable; pre-implementation artifact review remains separately exempt.

semantic_votes.rationale: The no-workspace-file rule preserves the actual change set under review; writing the export into the workspace would mutate and contaminate diff scope.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current prompt limits this path to supplied-artifact mode with an absent diff, and the Core utility contract requires diff-export/no-edit output as content or a host-native artifact.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve identical before-and-after workspace checks and invalidate downstream review or closure when the comparison changes or is unavailable.

semantic_votes.rationale: Formal readiness asserts a stronger evidence boundary, so ordinary authoring validation cannot substantiate that claim without the dedicated formal evidence gates.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current Core contract makes formal evidence non-bypassable when formal readiness is declared and repeats that condition as validation_loop.formal_scope_rule.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep formal readiness fail closed until the repository's formal-release evidence succeeds against the final material tree.

semantic_votes.rationale: A repair creates a new material and diff boundary, invalidating validation and review evidence tied to the superseded implementation state.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current Core visible_evidence_contract explicitly says a material edit invalidates prior evidence and a repair supersedes the old diff, requiring fresh validation and re-review.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Mark older diff evidence superseded or invalid and accept only fresh validation plus re-review of the latest repaired diff.

limitations: This independent ballot is static source-contract review; it does not prove real-host startup, runtime routing behavior, production enforcement, or installed user experience.
The review covers only the eight packet-named Root targets and their current source and Core authority context; it does not satisfy readability or professional-completeness formal attestations.
